## Changed
- Glowcubes now **defer to the standalone Glow Cubes mod** when it's installed: Hydrofarm's 17 glowcube recipes are disabled and its glowcubes are hidden from the creative tab, so you get a single set with no duplicates. Hydrofarm's glowcube **blocks stay registered**, so any already placed in a world are unaffected. This is the same approach Hydrofarm already uses for the standalone Capture Net. When the Glow Cubes mod isn't installed, nothing changes.
